tut.welcome.title: Welcome to NEXT PLAY
tut.welcome.text: Learn volleyball in a few minutes. You can skip any time and replay this from Settings.
tut.move.title: Move
tut.move.text: Drag the joystick to run on your side of the court.
tut.jump.title: Jump
tut.jump.text: Tap Jump to leap. You need to be in the air to spike and block.
tut.serve.title: Serve
tut.serve.text: Stand behind the back line and tap Serve to send the ball over the net.
tut.pass.title: Receive and Pass
tut.pass.text: Get under the ball and tap Pass to send it to your teammate.
tut.set.title: Set
tut.set.text: Tap Set to lift the ball high and soft for your hitter.
tut.spike.title: Spike
tut.spike.text: Tap Jump, then tap Spike when the ball is high near the net.
tut.block.title: Block
tut.block.text: Stand at the net, tap Jump, then tap Block as the attack comes.
tut.rules.title: Points and Rules
tut.rules.text: Every rally scores a point. A team gets 3 touches. Win a set at 25 points with a 2-point lead. Win 2 sets to win the match.
practice.serve.hint: Walk behind the back line, then tap Serve.
practice.receive.hint: The opponent serves. Move under the ball and tap Pass.
practice.pass.hint: Pass toward your teammate so they can play it.
practice.set.hint: Your teammate passes. Tap Set to lift it for your hitter.
practice.spike.hint: Teammate sets to you. Tap Jump, then Spike.
practice.block.hint: Go to the net. When they attack, tap Jump then Block.
practice.rally.hint: Play a full rally. Pass, set and attack!
map.start.title: Your start position
map.start.text: You begin here. You are on this side of the net.
map.net.title: Net and boundaries
map.net.text: The net divides the court. Lines mark the boundary. A ball landing outside the lines is out.
map.teams.title: Teammates and opponents
map.teams.text: Your teammates are on your side. Opponents are across the net.
map.controls.title: Controls here
map.controls.text: Use the same joystick and buttons. Tap Help any time for the full tutorial.
map.court_default.name: Training Court
